general.description: Ulaan Gazar is a planet with vasts expanses. It's name meaning "red land" in mongol came from its vasts meadows of redish grasses. Soon after the end of the second Fringes War, this place was meant to host a meeting with Irilan, Planetarists and a Pupeeter Emissary from the Red Quadrant. Alas, on the way, their ship crashed in Farlander III. By chance, the emissary survived with the help of a Human child and his dog, and finally achieve their perillous journey safely.
general.bar: Visitors and planeters enjoying Kumiis, Suutei tsai, and Arkhi, talking about petty things.
